verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken background: the photo is pieced together, with hard vertical seams around x≈125 and x≈640 that make a lighter centre panel, and the palm is blown up until it looks soft and pixelated. A at least keeps the logo lockup together and centred (icon, rule, B.E.A.C.H, dotted rule and the starred tagline). It's still undersized for the 16:9 frame, and the dotted rule doesn't match the solid rule above it. B breaks the lockup apart: the headline and solid rule sit off-centre to the left, the dotted rule and tagline drift right, and the two stars are flung to the canvas edges, far from the tagline they framed.
